description: Pseudonymous swimmer identifier assigned by the author. Stable across meets within this dataset. Not linkable to any external identifier.
Short machine key for the meet.
Full name of the meet as published in the source results.
First day of the meet. Swim day within a multi-day meet is not always known; see notes.
Swimmer age as published. Missing where the source did not publish ages.
Competition sex category as published. All records are M.
Event contested. All records are 200 FR.
Pool course. All records are SCY (short course yards).
Entry time as published. Missing where the source did not publish seed times.
Official finishing time for the swim.
Cumulative elapsed time at 200 yards. Equals final_time.
Provenance of the record: source page or document and the date it was retrieved.
